strategies.name: Detection of Obfuscated Files or Information

analytics.name: Analytic 1851
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Obfuscated Files or Information by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: open() with O_CREAT on path LIKE '/data/data/%/files/%' for binary or dex content by app_package NOT IN $LegitDynamicLoaders$]; Module Load via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: DexClassLoader() or dlopen() called with path argument matching file written in preceding $DecryptExecWindow$]; Network Connection Creation via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: React Native, Unity, Xamarin runtime packages — legitimate apps that use dynamic code loading. Tightening: empty list (all dynamic loading flagged). Loosening: broad list reduces FP for game engines. Derive from MDM-approved app catalog.
Default 60s between file write and module load. Tightening: 10s — synchronous decrypt-load pattern.
Per-app known CDN/update endpoints from 30-day network baseline. Derive by measurement.
Default 120s between module load and novel network connection.

log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: DexClassLoader() or dlopen() called with path argument matching file written in preceding $DecryptExecWindow$

analytics.name: Analytic 1852
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Obfuscated Files or Information by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]; Network Traffic Flow via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Per-app declared CDN/update endpoints from 30-day baseline.
Default 7.0 bits Shannon entropy. Calibrate against known-good app responses.
Default 1024 bytes — exclude trivial config responses.
Default 120s between download and new destination first seen.
